value.value: bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(prismpm template check) && (prismpm lock check)'

bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(cd app && lexlean fmt --check && lexlean lock --check) && (bash -euo pipefail -c '"'"'case "${PRISM_PROOF_EVENT:-}" in pull_request:*|merge_group:*|push:refs/heads/main) if cargo run -q --locked -p xtask -- proof-reuse; then exit 0; fi ;; esac; rm -rf .prism-proof; prismpm --project app verify | tee .prism-proof.log; attestation=$(sed -n "s/^verified attestation: \([0-9a-f]\{64\}\)$/\1/p" .prism-proof.log); rm -f .prism-proof.log; cargo run -q --locked -p xtask -- proof-keep "$attestation"'"'"')'

bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- check crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/thermostat --out crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/thermostat-prism --name thermostat --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z) && (cd crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/thermostat-prism && lexlean fmt --check && lexlean lock --check && lexlean verify && prismpm check) && (rm -rf target/uorust-self) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- mir . --out target/mir) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- project . --out target/uorust-self --name uorust --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z --mir target/mir --verdicts lift-verdicts.toml) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- check . --out target/uorust-self --name uorust --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z --register frontier.toml --mir target/mir --verdicts lift-verdicts.toml) && (cd target/uorust-self && lexlean fmt --check && lexlean lock --check && lexlean verify && prismpm check) && (rm -rf target/uorust-advised) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- project crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/advised --out target/uorust-advised --name advised --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z --advisories crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/advised/advisory-db) && (cd target/uorust-advised && lexlean fmt --check && lexlean lock --check && lexlean verify && prismpm check)'

bash prism-factory/written.sh crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/mir-path/lift-verdicts.toml -- bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- mir crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/mir-path --out target/mir-fixture) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- prove crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/mir-path --out target/mir-fixture-prove --scratch target/mir-fixture-scratch --name walk --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z --mir target/mir-fixture --verdicts crates/uorust/tests/fixtures/mir-path/lift-verdicts.toml)'

bash prism-factory/written.sh lift-verdicts.toml -- bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- mir . --out target/mir) && (cargo run -q --locked -p uorust -- prove . --out target/uorust-prove --scratch target/mir-prove --name uorust --last-modified 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z --mir target/mir --verdicts lift-verdicts.toml)'
bash prism-factory/written.sh crates/certified/ crates/uorust/src/certified.rs -- bash prism-factory/sdk.sh '(just certified-project) && (just certified-export "" ) && (just certified-sync)'
